public.description: General citizen with limited file access and villager sighting form

collector.description: District collector with standard sighting form and administrative visibility

bfo.title: Beat Forest Officer
bfo.description: Receives assigned compensation claims from CFO, conducts ground inspections, and fills the multi-step compensation form

cfo.title: Circle Forest Officer
cfo.description: Assigns incoming compensation claims to BFO, and performs primary verification after BFO submission

rfo.title: Range Forest Officer
rfo.description: Performs secondary verification on compensation claims submitted by BFO and verified by CFO

dfo.title: Divisional Forest Officer
dfo.description: Final authority reviewing verified compensation claims and approving sanction/proceeding
